description: This file defines the CommentStorage class for handling comment entities in Drupal, including methods for retrieving comment threads, counts, and ordering.

classes.name: CommentStorage
classes.description: A storage handler class for comment entities, extending SQL content entity storage with custom methods for threaded comments and counts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the CommentStorage with dependencies and current user.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of CommentStorage from a container.

methods.name: getMaxThread
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum thread value for comments related to a specific comment.

methods.name: getMaxThreadPerThread
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum thread value within a specific thread for a comment.

methods.name: getDisplayOrdinal
methods.description: Calculates the display order position of a comment among its siblings.

methods.name: getNewCommentPageNumber
methods.description: Calculates the page number where a new comment will appear based on total comments and threading mode.

methods.name: getChildCids
methods.description: Fetches child comment IDs for given parent comments.

methods.name: loadThread
methods.description: Loads a thread of comments for an entity, with pagination and ordering.

methods.name: getUnapprovedCount
methods.description: Returns the count of unapproved (not published) comments.
